title: papaya manihot
intro: Papaya manihot, commonly known as Manihot esculenta, is a plant species that is part of the Euphorbiaceae family and is native to South America. It is known for its edible root and tubers, commonly used in various cultures for its nutritional and medicinal properties. The health benefits of papaya manihot include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, manage diabetes, and provide antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in papaya manihot include flavonoids, saponins, and anthocyanins, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities.
